mapper.select: select fav_id as favId, chat_id as chatId, fav_sort_id as favSortId, created_by as createdBy, created_time as createdTime, updated_by as updatedBy, updated_time as updatedTime from ssm_ai_analysis_fav where chat_id = #{chatId} and created_by = #{userName} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ssm_ai_analysis_fav ( chat_id, fav_sort_id, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time ) values ( #{chatId}, #{favSortId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedTime} )
